name: Tokino Yoriko
source:
She is the current headmaster of St. Lilium Academy. She was appointed to the school, which was at a standstill due to a declining birthrate, and has successfully restored it. In accordance with the school's motto, she places importance on the independence of students. Although she has a gentle and mild personality, she has a strong belief in his educational policy, and is looked up to not only by students but also by teachers.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq42/]official site[/url]]
